_note: Curated reference compositions. This list is hand-picked and deliberately short — it is the canonical set, not a survey. It feeds two things: the Meta Lineups section of the Meta tab, and the curated-comp bonus in lib/generate.ts, so adding a team here makes the generator prefer it. Validated: every team is 4 unique awakeners, spans at most 2 distinct realms (Chaos counts toward that cap), and contains no two variants of the same base character (Helot / Helot: Catena share the in-game slot B05 and can never be fielded together — see LYRA-NOTES). All IDs verified against SKeyDB.

teams.name: Kathigu-Ra — Ultra (Chaos+Ultra)
teams.notes: Kathigu-Ra DPS with Ultra support (Clementine/Horla weakness+vulnerable+Ultra access, Tinct buffs). Realm: CHAOS+ULTRA. Alternates (swap-ins if missing pieces): Ryker, Karen, Castor. Source: Mythag Compendium Meta Team Comp.

teams.name: Tawil — Pure Chaos (Monowil)
teams.notes: Tawil pure-Chaos carry ("Monowil") — aliemus/keyflare engine for endless exalts. Realm: CHAOS. Alternates (swap-ins if missing pieces): Ramona: Timeworn, Ogier, Ramona. Source: Mythag Compendium Meta Team Comp.

teams.name: Liz — Chaos (Ultra+Chaos)
teams.notes: Liz poison DPS with Chaos poison support and Clementine Ultra buffs. Realm: CHAOS+ULTRA. Source: Mythag Compendium Meta Team Comp.

teams.name: Poison (Chaos+Caro)
teams.notes: Poison archetype: Xu applies/triggers, Nymphaea instant trigger, GDoll aliemus/weakness, Faint sustain. Realm: CHAOS+CARO. Source: Cheri New Player Handbook.

teams.name: Pollux — Pure Ultra
teams.notes: Pollux scaling combo DPS (core Castor) with Ultra weak/vuln support. Realm: ULTRA. Alternates (swap-ins if missing pieces): Tinct, Winkle, Hameln. Source: Mythag Compendium Meta Team Comp.

teams.name: Arachne — Singularity Ultra
teams.notes: Mono-Ultra. Arachne Singularity carry with Daffodil/Castor and Jenkin crit buffs. Realm: ULTRA. Source: Cheri New Player Handbook.

teams.name: Doresain — Caro core
teams.notes: Doresain Corpse-stacking DPS (sole assault); Pickman builds STR, Thais enables embryo/copies, Saya provides corrosion + Aliemus battery. Realm: CARO. Alternates (swap-ins if Saya is missing): Aigis, then Faint. Source: Mythag Compendium Meta Team Comp.

teams.name: Sorel — Caro core
teams.notes: Sorel does serious damage but is wholly dependent on being fed, so the other three exist to enable her. Thais is the embryo and Aliemus engine she scales on, Pickman stacks temporary STR onto her burst turn while generating embryos of his own, and Faint keeps a low-HP-scaling carry alive through hits that would otherwise end the run. Pure Caro.

teams.name: Mouchette — Strike (Chaos+Caro)
teams.notes: Strike hypercarry built around Mouchette, whose damage is among the highest in the game but who folds without breathing room. Helot is the multiplier: his Exalt draws two Strikes and raises all Strike damage for the turn. Aigis buys the turn Mouchette needs — her petrify is effectively a free round against a glass cannon — while feeding Keyflare and embryos. Thais covers the rest, generating embryos, Aliemus and Keyflare and copying cards. Realm: CHAOS+CARO.

teams.name: Pontos — Discard (Aequor+Caro)
teams.notes: Pontos' best home — the discard core cycles to his cards constantly (Corposant's discard engine stacks STR/Tentacle DMG, Aurita is the multihit payoff enjoying his crit DMG buff), and at E3 Aftershock makes the team cheap on Arithmetica. Saya brings Corrosion and 0-cost copies whose goo cleans up on discard. Pontos covers the comp's squishiness with shields and AOE STR down. Realm: AEQUOR+CARO. Source: Experimental log: Pontos.

teams.name: Vortice — Divine Aequor
teams.notes: Mono-Aequor. Vortice ramping AOE DPS (needs Drowned Innocence posse + Reload!/soulforge); defensive Aequor teammates stall while she ramps, Celeste revive. Realm: AEQUOR. Source: Cheri New Player Handbook.

teams.name: Murphy: Fauxborn — Lemurian (Astral Reign only)
teams.notes: All-Lemurian GMurphy team; Soulforge scales with 3 other Lemurians (max HP/shield). Arc-2 only — Lemurian Soulforge is inert in Faded Legacy. Realm: AEQUOR. Alternates (swap-ins if missing pieces): Faros, Thais, Murphy. Source: Mythag Compendium Meta Team Comp.
